nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Declares the core serializable schema types for agent definitions (SessionMode, SessionModel, AgentPolicy, AgentToolSelection, DelegationConfig, AgentDefinition, learnings config) used across the definitions subsystem.

nodes.name: SessionMode
nodes.summary: Enum of the supported session execution modes (e.g. normal, read-only) used to gate tool access.

nodes.name: SessionModel
nodes.summary: Schema struct describing which LLM provider/model a session or agent should use, with sensible defaults.

nodes.name: AgentTier
nodes.summary: Enum classifying an agent's tier/role level within the system.

nodes.name: AgentPolicy
nodes.summary: Schema struct capturing an agent's autonomy level, command-risk rules, and other security policy fields, convertible to a runtime SecurityPolicy via to_runtime_security().

nodes.name: SubAgentIsolation
nodes.summary: Enum describing the isolation level applied to sub-agents spawned by this agent (e.g., shared vs isolated workspace).

nodes.name: SubAgentRef
nodes.summary: Reference to a sub-agent definition that this agent is permitted to delegate to.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring which skills are enabled/available for an agent and their loading behavior.

nodes.name: AgentToolSelection
nodes.summary: Schema struct describing an agent's allowed/denied tool set and related tool-use configuration.

nodes.name: DelegationConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring how and whether an agent may delegate work to sub-agents, with defaults.

nodes.name: AgentDefinition
nodes.summary: The core serializable schema describing a full agent definition: identity, policy, session model, tools, skills, delegation, and capabilities. Central type of the definitions subsystem.

nodes.name: AgentLearningsConfig
nodes.summary: Schema struct configuring how an agent's learnings (accumulated knowledge) are stored and surfaced, with defaults.

nodes.name: resolver.rs
nodes.summary: Implements recursive resolution and merging of agent definitions, combining a definition with its parent/base definitions across capabilities, session model, agent policy, tools, skills, and delegation config.

nodes.name: get_raw_definition
nodes.summary: Fetches the raw, unresolved AgentDefinition for a given agent id from the definitions store.

nodes.name: resolve_with_depth
nodes.summary: Recursively resolves an agent definition against its parent chain up to a maximum depth, guarding against cycles via a visited set.

nodes.name: merge_definitions
nodes.summary: Merges a child agent definition onto its parent, combining capabilities, session model, policy, tools, skills, and delegation config field-by-field.

nodes.name: merge_capabilities
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child capability sets (coding, desktop, browser, etc.) for a resolved agent definition.

nodes.name: merge_coding_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child coding-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_desktop_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child desktop-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_browser_cap
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child browser-capability configuration.

nodes.name: merge_session_model
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child SessionModel settings, letting the child override the parent's model/provider choice where specified.

nodes.name: merge_agent_policy
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child AgentPolicy settings such as autonomy level and risk rules.

nodes.name: merge_tools
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child tool-selection configuration, combining allow/deny lists.

nodes.name: merge_skills_config
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child skills configuration.

nodes.name: merge_delegation_config
nodes.summary: Merges parent and child sub-agent delegation configuration.

nodes.name: messages.rs
nodes.summary: Converts internal message representations into Anthropic-native wire format, extracting system blocks, applying prompt-cache-control markers, and producing sidecar sibling content blocks.

nodes.name: extract_system
nodes.summary: Extracts and separates system-prompt content from the message list when converting to Anthropic's native wire format, handling cache-control markers.

nodes.name: render_system_blocks
nodes.summary: Renders the extracted system-prompt parts into Anthropic's system-block wire format, applying prompt-cache-control where appropriate.

nodes.name: stamp_trailing_cache_control
nodes.summary: Stamps a cache_control marker on the trailing eligible content block(s) of the message list to enable Anthropic prompt caching.

nodes.name: strip_cache_scope_markers
nodes.summary: Strips internal cache-scope markers from messages before sending them to the Anthropic API.

nodes.name: finalize_wire_hygiene
nodes.summary: Performs final cleanup/normalization passes on the message list to ensure it is well-formed for the Anthropic wire format.

nodes.name: anthropic_thinking_block
nodes.summary: Converts an internal thinking/reasoning representation associated with a tool call into an Anthropic-native thinking content block.

nodes.name: convert_content_block
nodes.summary: Converts a single internal content block into its Anthropic-native wire representation.

nodes.name: sidecar_to_anthropic_sibling_blocks
nodes.summary: Converts internal 'sidecar' content (auxiliary data attached to a message) into the sibling content blocks expected by the Anthropic API.

nodes.name: persist.rs
nodes.summary: Persists compact-boundary markers into the session file in place, splitting summary and tail content and detecting already-compacted sessions.

nodes.name: content_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain-text content of a message for persistence/boundary-marker purposes.

nodes.name: split_summary_and_tail
nodes.summary: Splits a compacted message list into the summary portion and the preserved tail portion for persistence.

nodes.name: append_in_place_compact_boundary
nodes.summary: Appends a compact-boundary marker to the session's persisted message log in place, recording the token delta from compaction.

nodes.name: persist_session_memory_after_compact
nodes.summary: Persists any extracted session-memory content to disk immediately after a compaction pass completes.

nodes.name: AppendedCompactBoundary
nodes.summary: Result describing the compact-boundary marker that was appended to a session's persisted log.

nodes.name: manual.rs
nodes.summary: Drives user-triggered manual compaction (run_manual_compact), producing a ManualCompactResult/Summary and persisting the outcome to session state.

nodes.name: run_manual_compact
nodes.summary: Drives a user-triggered manual compaction of a session: loads state, runs the compactor, persists the result, and returns a summary.

nodes.name: ManualCompactResult
nodes.summary: Result of a manual-compaction request, including the resulting summary/status returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: ManualCompactSummary
nodes.summary: Summary statistics for a completed manual compaction (e.g., messages compacted, tokens saved).

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Provides token-counting utilities (count_tokens, count_message_tokens) backed by a per-model tokenizer encoder, used to size messages against context budgets.

nodes.name: encoder_for_model
nodes.summary: Selects and returns the appropriate token encoder for a given LLM model identifier.

nodes.name: count_with_encoder
nodes.summary: Counts the number of tokens in a text string using a specific pre-selected encoder.

nodes.name: count_content_tokens
nodes.summary: Counts the tokens represented by a structured message content block (text, tool calls, etc.).

nodes.name: count_message_tokens
nodes.summary: Counts the total tokens in a single message including its content and metadata overhead.

nodes.name: plan_preservation.rs
nodes.summary: Detects plan-bearing messages and re-injects the active plan back into context after compaction so in-progress task plans survive summarization.

nodes.name: extract_active_plan
nodes.summary: Scans recent messages for the most recent plan-bearing content (e.g., an active TODO/plan tool call) and extracts it.

nodes.name: reinject_plan_after_compaction
nodes.summary: Re-injects the most recent active plan into the message history after compaction so in-progress plans aren't lost.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the session_memory subsystem, re-exporting compact, config, extract, sections, and state submodules.

nodes.name: state.rs
nodes.summary: Defines SessionMemoryState, a small struct tracking tool-call activity used to gate session-memory extraction.

nodes.name: SessionMemoryState
nodes.summary: Tracks per-session state for the session-memory feature, including a record_tool_calls() method to note tool-call activity that gates extraction timing.
